title: Timed Out, Not Declined
description: A gateway that never answers is a different failure than a gateway that says no outright — the ledger should be able to tell the two apart later.
successCondition: Pay an invoice using the timeout test card 4000000000000119. The response's payment.status is "timed_out" (not "declined") with failureReason containing "gateway_timeout". The invoice stays "open" afterward (GET /api/billing/invoices/:id). Querying payments via `npm run db:psql` confirms the row's status column literally stores 'timed_out', a distinct enum value from 'declined'.
hints: The mock gateway's card-to-outcome mapping is documented in docs/api/billing.md — 4000000000000119 is the timeout case, distinct from the decline card.
PaymentStatus is a 3-value enum (succeeded | declined | timed_out) in prisma/schema.prisma — check the exact stored value, not just that the invoice remained unpaid.
